blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce SM4RT, a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction from RGB videos. While existing feed-forward approaches typically address geometry reconstruction and motion estimation separately--and often predict motions in a single coordinate frame that must account for camera movement--SM4RT solves these tasks sequentially by first reconstructing 3D geometry and then bootstrapping motion estimation from the predicted structure. By expressing each pixel's 3D motion in its corresponding camera frame, SM4RT reduces ambiguity arising from camera motion. To address the sparsity of real-world motion labels, SM4RT further incorporates a weakly supervised loss that regularizes unlabeled point motions using labeled point positions at the other time step. We evaluate motion estimation on three dynamic-scene datasets--Kubric, Waymo, and Point Odyssey--and SM4RT achieves the best performance on most metrics compared with prior baselines. We additionally benchmark geometry reconstruction on five dynamic scene datasets and show that SM4RT achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods. Overall, our unified framework demonstrates that combining geometry reconstruction and motion estimation in a cascade not only avoids performance trade-offs but also enhances motion estimation through improved geometric reasoning.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Dynamic 3D scene reconstruction is fundamental to spatial understanding of the visual world. The goal is to recover fine-grained scene geometry and motion from RGB videos, enabling a wide range of applications. In robotics, it supports precise estimation of object pose, part articulation or point deformation; in computer vision, it facilitates simulating, novel-view rendering or editing dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: 动态3D场景重建对视觉世界的空间理解至关重要. 目标是从RGB视频中恢复精细的场景几何和运动,从而实现广泛的应用. 在机器人学中,它支持精确地估计物体的姿势,部分的表达或点变形;在计算机视觉中,它有利于模拟,新颖-视图渲染或编辑动态场景.

blocks.en: Simultaneously solving geometry reconstruction and motion estimation from RGB videos remains a substantial challenge, largely due to the strong coupling between these two tasks. Accurate motion estimation requires reliable 3D point locations at each time step [ 16 ] , while geometry reconstruction depends on consistent multi-view correspondences between 3D points and their 2D projections. However, in dynamic scenes this consistency breaks down, as dynamic motion violates the static assumptions underlying traditional multi-view geometry [ 18 , 10 ] . Consequently, geometry reconstruction and motion estimation are often addressed separately: the former through Structure from Motion [ 1 , 38 ] and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping [ 7 ] , which assume static environments and ignore modeling dynamic content; and the latter through scene flow estimation [ 16 , 19 , 36 , 45 ] or 3D point tracking [ 60 , 55 ] , leveraging estimated or sensed depth maps to provide 3D information for video inputs.
blocks.zh: 同时从RGB视频中解决几何重建和运动估计仍然是个重大挑战,这主要是由于这两项任务之间紧密结合。 精确运动估计需要在每个时间步[16]上可靠的3D点位置,而几何重建则依赖于3D点与其2D预测之间的一致多视图对应. 然而,在动态场景中,这种一致性崩溃了,因为动态运动违反了传统多视图几何学所基于的静态假设[18,10]. 因此,几何重构和运动估计往往被分别处理:前者通过结构从运动[1,38]和同步本地化和绘图[7],它们假设了静态环境而忽略了模型动态内容;后者通过场景流估计[16,19,36,45]或3D点跟踪[60,55],利用估计或感知深度地图为视频输入提供3D信息.

blocks.en: Feed-forward frameworks [ 51 , 28 , 49 , 48 , 23 ] have recently emerged as effective solutions for static 3D geometry reconstruction. These models bypass explicit triangulation by directly predicting 3D point positions from multi-view images, typically centered at a single camera’s coordinate frame to handle varying camera poses. The same architectures have been extended to dynamic scene reconstruction [ 21 , 10 , 57 , 41 , 25 , 17 ] , estimating 3D positions of every observed points across time to jointly model geometry and motion. While conceptually simple, such direct extensions are suboptimal: predicting future or past 3D point locations in another camera’s coordinate frame needs to jointly account for both global camera motion and local object motion, which is ambiguous, and therefore increasing the complexity of dynamic scene reconstruction task.
blocks.zh: 饲料推进框架[51、28、49、48、23]最近成为静态三维几何重建的有效解决办法。 这些模型通过直接从多视图图像中预测出3D点位置来绕过明确的三角定位,通常以单相机的坐标框为中心来处理相机的各种外观. 同样的建筑被扩展至动态场景重建[21,10,57,41,25,17],估计了不同时间所观测到的每个点的3D位置,以联合模型几何和运动. 虽然在概念上很简单,但这种直接扩展是次优的:预测未来或过去在另一相机坐标架上3D点位置,需要同时对全局相机运动和局部物体运动进行联合说明,两者都模棱两可,因此增加了动态场景重建任务的复杂性.

blocks.en: To address this limitation, our key insight is to disentangle camera motion from object motion in dynamic scenes. We make three observations: (1) motion estimation becomes simpler when camera motion is excluded, (2) accurately estimating object motion helps identify static points, and (3) camera motion naturally emerges from the multi-view geometry of these static points. Building on these insights, we focus solely on modeling object motion by predicting 3D point positions across time within each input camera’s coordinate frame. This formulation produces motion patterns that distinctly separate static and dynamic points, enabling robust camera motion estimation from static-point geometry predicted by existing feed-forward models. By defining motion in this disentangled space, we simplify dynamic scene reconstruction and improve the accuracy and coherence of its constituent tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个局限性,我们的关键洞察力是在动态场景中将相机运动从物体运动中分离出来. 我们做了三项观察:(1)排除相机运动时运动估计变得更简单;(2)准确估计物体运动有助于识别静态点;(3)相机运动自然地从这些静态点的多视几何中出现. 基于这些洞察力,我们只注重于通过预测每个输入相机坐标框内不同时间的三维点位置来模拟物体运动. 这种配方产生运动模式,将静态和动态点明确区分开来,使相机能从由现有向导模型预测的静态点几何中进行强力相机运动估计. 通过在这个分散的空间中定义运动,我们简化了动态场景重建,并提高其组成任务的准确性和一致性.

blocks.en: We introduce Structured Motion 4D Reconstruction (SM4RT), a multi-task cascade feed-forward model [ 5 ] that bootstraps motion estimation from geometry reconstruction for dynamic scene reconstruction (see Fig. 1 ). Built on the DUSt3R [ 51 ] architecture, SM4RT first predicts 3D point positions from two input video frames and then estimates their 3D motion as positional offsets. To enhance motion estimation, SM4RT modulates attention [ 46 ] between visual tokens based on predicted 3D locations. By ignoring global camera motion, SM4RT predicts per-frame 3D point motion within each camera coordinate frame, producing zero motion for static points. To address the sparsity of real-world point motion annotations, we introduce a weakly-supervised loss that regularizes unlabeled point motion based on labeled point positions from the other time step. Together, these designs enable SM4RT to reconstruct dynamic scenes more accurately and coherently.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了结构化运动4D重建(SM4RT),这是一种多任务级联向反馈模型[5],该模型为动态场景重建从几何重建中进行运动估计(见图1)。 由DUST3R [51] 架构所建,SM4RT首先从两个输入视频帧预测出3D点位置,再估计出它们的3D运动作为位置偏移. 为了增强运动估计,SM4RT在基于预测的3D位置的可视符号之间调制出注意[46]. 通过忽略全局相机运动,SM4RT预测每个相机坐标框内每帧3D点运动,产生静点零运动. 为了解决现实世界点动说明的一丝不苟,我们引入了由弱监督的损失,根据从另一个时间步起的被标记点位置,将无标签点动规范化. 这些设计共同使SM4RT能够更准确更连贯地重建动态场景.

blocks.en: We extensively evaluate SM4RT under multiple established setups. Following [ 41 ] , we evaluate the effectiveness of dynamic scene reconstruction on Kubric-F [ 15 ] and Waymo [ 42 ] dataset. Our SM4RT outperforms previous state-of-the-arts in terms of estimating object flow on both datasets. Meanwhile, we evaluate the effectiveness of geometry reconstruction on 5 datasets: Sintel [ 4 ] , Point Odyssey [ 62 ] , Bonn [ 35 ] , Kubric-F [ 15 ] , and KITTI [ 12 ] . Our SM4RT achieves competitive performance than previous methods in terms of two-view depth estimation. Our results demonstrate that our unified framework for geometry reconstruction and motion estimation does not compromise the performance of either task. Instead, our cascade design enhances motion estimation with geometry reconstruction. We believe this technical insight would facilitate the development of more advanced feed-forward model architecture for dynamic scene reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们广泛评估SM4RT在多个既定设置下. 继[41]之后,我们评价了库布里克-F[15]和Waymo[42]数据集上动态场景重建的有效性. 我们的SM4RT在估计两个数据集上的对象流方面比之前的"最先进的"表现. 同时,我们评价5个数据集几何重建的有效性: 辛特尔[4],奥德赛角 [62],波恩 [35],库布里克-F [15],和KITTI [12]. 我们的SM4RT在双视深度估计方面比起以前的方法实现了竞争性能. 我们的成果表明,我们进行几何重建和运动估计的统一框架并不影响这两项任务的执行。 反之,我们的级联设计能用几何重建增强运动估计. 我们认为,这种技术洞察力将有利于为动态场景重建开发更先进的向导模型建筑。

blocks.en: Dynamic scene reconstruction involves reconstructing 3D scene geometry and estimating motion from RGB videos. In this section, we briefly introduce the definition of these tasks and review the seminal feed-forward model–DUSt3R [ 51 ] .

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of the framework. SM4RT is a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction. It first performs geometry reconstruction using a DUSt3R backbone ( blue modules), then feeds the predicted 3D geometry into a transformer-based decoder followed by a DPT head to estimate motion ( red modules). SM4RT trains the network with a fully-supervised regression loss ℒ conf \mathcal{L}_{\textsf{conf}} based on ground-truth dynamic point maps and object flow; at the same time, it incorporates a weakly-supervised Chamfer loss ℒ CD \mathcal{L}_{\textsf{CD}} that regularizes unlabeled point motion based on labeled point positions from the other time step, to handle the sparsity of motion labels.
blocks.zh: 图3:框架概览。 SM4RT是动态场景重建的多任务级联回馈模式. 它首先使用DUST3R主干线(蓝色模块)来进行几何重建,再将所预测的3D几何输入到以变压器为主的解码器中,再由DPT头来估计运动(红色模块). SM4RT基于地-真动态点图和对象流,以完全监督的回归损失 Lconf\mathcal{L}_{\textsf{conf}对网络进行训练;同时,它还包含一个被弱监督的Chamfer损失 L CD\mathcal{L}_{\textsf{CD}},根据从另一个时间步起的标注点位置,将无标签的点运动规范化,以处理运动标签的抽筋.

blocks.en: SM4RT is a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction from RGB videos. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , it adopts a geometry-first cascade: dense 3D geometry is reconstructed first and then used to bootstrap motion estimation. To reduce ambiguity from camera motion, SM4RT represents dynamics with object flow rather than motion in a camera-entangled coordinate frame. We further introduce a weakly supervised loss that regularizes unlabeled point motions, enabling the model to better leverage sparsely annotated real-world data.
blocks.zh: SM4RT是一款由RGB视频提供动态场景重建的多任务级联回馈模式. 如图3所说明的,它采用了几何-第一级联:密集的三维几何首先被重建,然后用于靴形运动估计。 为了减少相机运动的模糊性,SM4RT在相机缠绕的坐标框中代表有物体流的动力学而非运动. 我们进一步引入一种监督不力的损失,这种损失使无标签点运动合法化,使模型能够更好地利用附加说明的稀少的现实世界数据。

blocks.en: For motion estimation, we feed the updated tokens G 1 G_{1} and G 2 G_{2} into a transformer decoder, where they cross-attend to enhance spatio-temporal feature representations. Because motion estimation depends on precise 3D localization of each pixel, we inject 3D positional information into the decoder. Specifically, since each token corresponds to an image patch, we compute its 3D position by averaging the predicted 3D coordinates of pixels within that patch. Following prior work in visual correspondence [ 30 ] and robotic manipulation [ 22 ] , we incorporate 3D information by modulating the attention mechanism–encouraging tokens to attend more strongly to spatially nearby ones in 3D. We implement this via rotary positional embeddings [ 40 ] , encoding relative 3D positions directly in the attention layers (see [ 40 ] for details).

blocks.en: During dynamic fine-tuning, SM4RT must learn motion prediction without forgetting the static 3D reconstruction ability inherited from pretraining. We address this with EMA-based static self-distillation [ 43 ] . Specifically, we maintain an exponential moving average copy of the online model as a detached teacher and encourage the student to match the teacher’s predicted 3D pointmaps on valid static pixels. The loss is applied to both point predictions in the reference view and points expressed in the other view. Restricting this distillation to static regions preserves geometric reconstruction behavior while avoiding conflict with supervised motion learning on dynamic regions.
blocks.zh: 在动态微调过程中,SM4RT必须学习运动预测,而不会忘记从预训中继承的静态3D重建能力. 我们用基于EMA的静态自沉[43]来解决这个问题。 具体来说,我们保持一个指数移动的在线模型平均副本,作为脱开的老师,并鼓励学生在有效的静态像素上与老师预测的三维点图相匹配. 损失既适用于参考观点中的点预测,也适用于另一种观点中表述的观点。 将这种蒸馏限制在静态区域可以保持几何重建行为,同时避免与动态区域受监督的运动学习相冲突.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We train SM4RT on a diverse mixture of static (WildRGBD [ 54 ] , BlendedMVS [ 58 ] ) and dynamic (Waymo [ 42 ] , Kubric-F [ 15 ] , Spring [ 33 ] and Point Odyssey [ 62 ] ) datasets. This collection provides a wide range of real-world, synthetic, indoor, and outdoor scenes.
We closely follow prior work [ 51 , 41 ] to prepare ground-truth point position and motion annotations. For Point Odyssey, we annotate 2D pixels using the corresponding 3D point trajectories provided by the simulator. For Waymo and Kubric-F, motion labels are derived from the 3D bounding box poses of each object, while 3D position labels are obtained from Lidar measurements in Waymo and from unprojected rendered depth maps in Kubric-F. Spring provides ground-truth disparity and flow in adjacent frames. We extend these labels to aggregate for long-time difference flow with consistency filtering to avoid mismatches. For WildRGBD and BlendedMVS, position labels are derived from unprojected depth maps, and motion labels are set to zero.

我们密切关注先前的工作[51、41],以编写地面真相立场和动议说明。 对于点 Odyssey,我们使用模拟器提供的相应3D点轨迹对2D像素进行注释. 对于Waymo和Kubric-F,运动标签取自每个物体的3D边框外观,而从Waymo的Lidar测量和Kubric-F的未预测到的深度地图取出3D位置标签. Spring提供了相邻框架的地真相和流. 我们将这些标签扩展为长期差分流的聚合,同时进行一致性过滤来避免不匹配. 对于"WildRGBD"和"BlendedMVS",位置标签由未投影的深度地图所衍生出,而运动标签被设定为零.

blocks.en: We summarize our results in Table 1 . Our method SM4RT demonstrates consistently strong performance across all three dynamic scene datasets. While achieving competitive results in point map estimation ( L r ​ e ​ l L_{rel} ) against leading methods, our approach significantly outperforms all baselines in the more challenging tasks of object flow and relative pose estimation. blocks.en: 5  Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learning based 3D reconstruction. The field of 3D scene reconstruction has explored diverse 3D representations, including implicit methods, meshes [ 2 ] , and 3D Gaussian Splatting [ 53 , 13 ] . Parallel to these, explicit point cloud reconstruction has seen significant advances. Foundational models like DUSt3R [ 51 ] have revolutionized the field by creating a unified framework for estimating depth, camera intrinsics, and extrinsics from stereo views. Subsequent works such as MASt3R [ 28 ] further enable robust 3D image matching, and several other works based on DUSt3R [ 47 , 48 , 50 ] extend the model to perform global scene reconstruction from video.
Our work harnesses DUSt3R’s proven strengths in 3D scene reconstruction and alignment as a foundation, allowing our model to perform 4D sceneflow estimation with point cloud reconstructions.
blocks.zh:
基于学习的3D重建. 3D场景重建领域探索了多种3D表达方式,包括隐含的方法, meshes [2],和3D高斯平板. [53,13]. 与此同时,明确的云层重建取得了重大进展。 DUST3R [51]等基础模型通过创建一个统一的框架来估算深度,相机内在,以及从立体视图中推算出外相,从而对领域进行了革命. 之后的作品如MAST3R [28] 进一步实现了强力3D图像匹配,还有多部基于DUST3R [47,48,50] 的作品将模型从视频中扩展为进行全局场景重建.
我们的工作利用了DUST3R在三维场景重建与对接中证明的优势,

blocks.en: 4D reconstruction. Beyond static 3D, 4D reconstruction aims to model temporal dynamics. While some methods extend 3D Gaussian Splatting (3D-GS) [ 52 ] , a key approach is tracking point correspondences over time. Earlier methods such as MonST3R [ 61 ] combined depth with optical flow trackers, such as RAFT [ 44 , 45 ] , to reconstruct 3D point movement. More recently, end-to-end networks inspired by DUSt3R [ 51 ] directly predict point clouds and their motion.
blocks.zh: 4D重建. 除了静态3D外,4D重建还旨在模拟时间动态. 虽然一些方法扩展了3D高斯平板(3D-GS)[52],但一个关键的方法是跟踪随时间推移的点通信. 更早的方法如MonST3R [61]将深度与光学流跟踪器结合,如RAFT [44,45],来重建3D点运动. 最近,由DUST3R[51]所启发的端到端网络直接预测出点云及其运动.

blocks.en: A critical challenge in this area is the disentanglement of object motion from camera motion. Several works have addressed this: Monst3R [ 61 ] introduced static mask prediction, integrating RAFT to enhance static background matching. DynaDUSt3R [ 21 ] attempts to directly predict object motion while keeping 3D reconstruction unchanged. Dynamic Point Maps (DPM) [ 41 ] address this by introducing time invariance as well as viewpoint invariance. However, by predicting motion into a single coordinate frame, these methods often struggle to fully separate object motion from camera motion. Instead, our model guarantees that object flow is predicted from the same frame as the point map. Additionally, we leverage positional information from predicted point maps to aid downstream decoder blocks in predicting displacement from the original point cloud, simplifying the motion estimation task.
blocks.zh: 该领域的一个关键挑战是将物体运动从相机运动中分离出来. 几部作品都针对了这一点: Monst3R [61] 引入了静态口罩预测,整合了RAFT来增强静态背景匹配. DynaDUST3R [21] 尝试直接预测对象运动,同时保持3D重建不变. 动态点地图[41]通过引入时间变化和观点变化来解决这一问题。 然而,通过将运动预测成一个单一的坐标框,这些方法往往难以将物体运动与相机运动完全分开. 相反,我们的模型保证对象流是从与点图相同的框架来预测的. 此外,我们利用预测点图中的位置信息,帮助下游解码器块预测从原点云中流出,简化了运动估计任务.

blocks.en: 6  Summary
blocks.zh: 6 总结

blocks.en: This paper introduces SM4RT, a multi-task cascade feed-forward model for dynamic scene reconstruction from RGB videos. The model first reconstructs 3D geometry and subsequently bootstraps motion estimation from the predicted structure. By expressing 3D motion within each pixel’s corresponding camera frame, SM4RT effectively disentangles object motion from the ambiguity of camera movement. The framework also incorporates a weakly-supervised loss to address the common challenge of sparse motion labels in real-world data.

blocks.en: We evaluated SM4RT on multiple dynamic-scene datasets, where it consistently outperformed all baselines for motion estimation tasks. Furthermore, it achieved competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods for geometry reconstruction. These results demonstrate that a cascaded, geometry-informed approach enhances motion estimation accuracy without compromising the performance of either task, leading to improved overall geometric reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们在多个动态场景数据集上对SM4RT进行了评价,该数据集在运动估计任务上的表现始终超过所有基线。 此外,它还以最先进的几何重建方法取得了竞争力。 这些结果表明,采用有级联、几何知识的方法可以提高运动估计的准确性,同时又不损害任一任务的业绩,从而改进总体几何推理。

blocks.en: Our SM4RT operates on a pair of video frames and predicts the motion between them, but extending this framework to long-horizon videos remains a significant challenge. In addition, SM4RT currently relies on the DUSt3R backbone for geometry reconstruction, which can degrade in the presence of dynamic object motion. Developing methods that maintain robust geometry reconstruction in dynamic scenes is an important direction for future work. We agree that multi-frame reconstruction is an important extension. We deliberately study the two-frame setting to isolate the contribution of geometry priors to dynamic reconstruction. Importantly, our cascaded design is not tied to a specific backbone or temporal window, and can serve as a plug-and-play dynamic module for multi-frame models such as VGGT [ 48 ] and DA3 [ 31 ] . Their temporally aggregated geometry can provide stronger correspondence priors, while our object-flow module separates camera-induced motion from independently moving regions. Moreover, the 3D RoPE formulation encodes geometry in a spatially consistent coordinate system and can be extended with temporal indexing to support correspondence reasoning across longer sequences.

blocks.en: To retrieve the relative pose between two frames, we perform PnP RANSAC [ 27 , 11 ] between the reconstructed point clouds P i ​ ( t i , π i ) ​ and ​ P i ​ ( t i , π j ) P_{i}(t_{i},\pi_{i})\text{ and }P_{i}(t_{i},\pi_{j}) . A critical factor for accurate pose estimation is reference point selection, as static points yield more robust and precise camera motion estimates. We derive a static object mask from the confidence scores of the flow prediction head, based on the observation that confidence scores in static regions (where the flow head is expected to output zero) are significantly higher than in dynamic regions. Specifically, we generate the static mask by applying a threshold to the confidence score map; in this work, we set the threshold as conf ≥ 7 \text{conf}\geq 7 . Conceptually, object flow factors out camera motion and provides a structured target: static regions should have near-zero motion, while independently moving objects retain coherent motion. This is also consistent with robotics works using object-centric 3D motion or articulation flow as action-relevant representations [ 8 , 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 对象流训练改进了所有度量衡,直接支持我们的设计. 在概念上,物体流因子出相机运动并提供一个结构化的目标:静态区域应该有近于零的运动,而独立移动的物体则保留了连贯的运动. 这与机器人作品也是一致的,机器人作品使用以物体为中心的3D运动或发音流作为与动作相关的表达 [8,59].

blocks.en: A.4 Voxelization for Chamfer Distance Loss
blocks.zh: A.4 Chamfer 远程损失的蒸发

blocks.en: To balance accurate nearest neighbor search with computational efficiency, we discretize the coordinate space into grids with a resolution of 1000 per axis, resulting in N = 1000 3 N=1000^{3} voxels. Since camera movement results in partial overlap between input point clouds, we restrict the Chamfer distance loss to be computer only on intersecting regions. These are efficiently identified via voxel occupancy intersection. Finally, we employ a sigmoid scheduler to gradually increase the weight of the Chamfer distance loss ℒ CD \mathcal{L}_{\text{CD}} from 0 to 4.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡准确的近邻搜索和计算效率,我们把坐标空间盘成网格,每轴分辨率为1000个,结果为N=1000 3 N=1000^{3}voxels. 由于相机移动导致输入点云部分重叠,因此我们限制Chamfer相距损失只能是相交区域上的计算机. 通过Voxel入住的交叉路口有效识别出这些东西. 最后,我们使用 sigmoid 排程器, 逐渐将 Chamfer 距离损失的重量从 0 增加到 4 。

blocks.en: A.5 Pretrained Weight Setup
blocks.zh: A.5 预装重量设置

blocks.en: Instead of training from scratch, SM4RT is fine-tuned from the MASt3R [ 29 ] checkpoint. We initialize the encoder, decoders, and depth prediction heads with their respective pretrained weights. Furthermore, we initialize the flow prediction head using the pretrained weights of the depth prediction head. During training, the weights of the encoder are frozen, while all other components remain trainable.
blocks.zh: SM4RT不是从零开始训练,而是从MAST3R[29]检查站进行微调. 我们初始化了编码器,解码器, 以及深度预测头部 和各自的预先训练的重量。 此外,我们利用深度预测头的预受重量,初始化了流量预测头. 在训练期间,编码器的重量被冻结,而所有其他部件仍然可以训练.

blocks.en: A.6 Details about Training Datasets
blocks.zh: A.6 培训数据集的细节

blocks.en: Obtaining ground truth object flow labels across arbitrary frame intervals is challenging when point trajectories in world coordinates are unavailable. For Kubric, we modify the preprocessing pipeline in TapVid3D [ 24 ] to transform ground truth object poses into relative poses across different timestamps, thereby generating pseudo ground truth data for flow supervision. For Waymo, we derive the relative object pose by aligning the eight vertices of the ground truth bounding boxes. Finally, for Spring, we aggregated the optical flow on consecutive frames with a cycle consistency filtering on selected clips where the cameras stay still. The estimated pose is then applied to points within the corresponding bounding boxes to generate object flow data. The properties of the datasets used for training are listed in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 如果世界坐标上点的轨迹不可用,那么在任意的相框间隔间取出地面真理物体流标就具有挑战性。 对库布里克来说,我们修改了TapVid3D [24]中的预处理管道,将地面真理物体所构成的外观转化为跨越不同时间戳的相对外观,从而生成了用于流量监督的伪地真理数据. 对于Waymo来说,我们通过对接地真相框的8个顶点来得出相对对象的姿势. 最后,对于斯普林,我们汇总了连续相框上的光学流,在相机静止的选定相片上进行循环一致性过滤. 然后将估计的姿势应用于相邻框内的点来生成对象流数据. 用于培训的数据集的属性见表4。
